column1: # the reference application unit names. Single source of truth for
# the Julia table (units.jl) and the Rust static analysis (core/src/dimensions.rs).
# @prefix <name> <power of ten> SI prefix accepted by units marked `p`
# <dimension> is the exponent of length, mass, time, current, temperature, amount and
# luminous intensity, comma separated. `p` means the unit also exists with every prefix
# (`km`, `kN`, `kWh`). Names are case sensitive. A plain name always wins over a prefix
# reading (`min` is the minute, `mi` the mile). The definition is parsed by Unitful's
# `uparse` and must have the stated dimension (tested).
# Offset temperatures: a value in °C or °F becomes kelvin with its offset at once
# (EqRuntime `OffsetUnit`, the definition here is only the scale); Δ°C and Δ°F are differences.
